Robert Browning. 1812–1889

725. Parting at Morning

 
R
OUND
 the cape of a sudden came the sea,
 
 
And the sun look’d over the mountain’s rim:
 
 
And straight was a path of gold for him,
 
 
And the need of a world of men for me.
